inlines.v: GROSSLY, adverb In bulky or large parts; coarsely. This matter is grossly pulverized. 1. Greatly; palpably; enormously; as, this affair has been grossly misrepresented. 2. Greatly; shamefully; as grossly criminal. 3. Coarsely; without refinement or delicacy; as language grossly vulgar. 4. Without art or skill.
